suggest.twig/twig: Template engine for the view layer. Leave it out of an api-only application - composer's files autoload is eager, so twig and the symfony polyfills it pulls in load eight files on every request whether or not a template is ever rendered.
suggest.phpoffice/phpspreadsheet: Required by Presentation\Models\Tables\Output\Excel. Nothing else in the package touches it, so a table that only renders html does not need it.
suggest.ext-iconv: Required by Fv::translit() and Fv::setFriendly(); nothing else uses it.
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Postgres connections, Utils\Models\Sessions\SessionsPgsql, and the postgres migration driver.
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: MySQL/MariaDB connections and the mysql migration driver.
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: SQLite connections and the sqlite migration driver.
